name: oddbout
description: ODDBOUT creation and review skills for Codex. Reuses your existing ODDBOUT MCP connection; does not register a second server or sign you in.

interface.longDescription: Create, review and register fighters using your existing ODDBOUT MCP connection. This local Codex package installs the create-fighter skill. MCP setup and your own Google sign-in are separate. It does not install a Dots cloud App, start generation or include a local generation runtime.
